title: CDS par spread with mid-period default accrual
prompt: All figures and markets in this question are synthetic. Three one-year premium periods; defaults occur only at period midpoints. Each supplied risk-neutral pricing probability is conditional on survival to the start of that year. Protection pays loss-given-default immediately at default. Annual coupon is paid at each year-end only if alive, plus exactly half an annual coupon at midpoint default. Rates are continuously compounded. Return protection-leg PV, risky premium annuity per unit notional per unit annual spread, par spread, and fair upfront paid by the protection buyer when the contractual running coupon is100bp. No counterparty risk.

outputs.name: risky_annuity
outputs.description: Premium PV divided by notional and annual decimal spread.

outputs.name: upfront
outputs.description: Amount paid at inception by protection buyer at100bp coupon.

instructions: Solve the synthetic quantitative-finance question using its supplied inputs and conventions. A calculator or local code is allowed. External market data is unnecessary.
